name: Dalhousie University
summary: Halifax, Nova Scotia university with about 20,000 students from 120+ countries, 13 faculties and 300+ degree programs, plus a Truro campus.

ib.text: IB Diploma with at least 26 points including bonus points, plus your program's courses: English, and Maths, Chemistry, Physics or Biology at SL or HL. Maths AI SL is accepted for Maths.

noDeadline: Most programs: where space is available; apply early

programmes.name: Marine Biology
programmes.about: Study marine animals and plants from the shore and the water, with a Blue Planet course in year 2, marine ecology and mammalogy later, and a new on-campus marine biodiversity centre. Optional Science Co-op with three work terms.
programmes.ib: English and Maths (AA or AI, SL or HL) plus a minimum 75% overall average in Dalhousie's terms; you enter the Faculty of Science undeclared and declare Marine Biology after year 1.
programmes.selectionNote: English, pre-calculus-level Maths and three more academic subjects, with a 75% minimum average; the minimum does not guarantee a place. 26 points is the Diploma floor.

flagshipSource.title: Marine Biology (BSc or BA): the ocean as a classroom, with fieldwork and a marine biodiversity centre

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.about: Software development, algorithms, networking and graphics, with six customizable majors from Cybersecurity and AI to Human-Computer Interaction, and optional paid co-op of up to 12 months.
programmes.ib: Maths (AA or AI, SL or HL; AI SL accepted) and English; Dalhousie asks Ontario-style minimums of 65% in Pre-calculus, 70% in Maths and 65% in English.
programmes.selectionNote: Maths, English and three more university-prep subjects with a 70% overall average; the minimum does not guarantee a place. 26 points is the Diploma floor.

flagshipSource.title: Bachelor of Computer Science: six majors, optional paid co-op and a link to ShiftKey Labs

faculties.name: Faculty of Science
faculties.line: You enter undeclared and declare a major after year 1; Pre-calculus-level Maths and a 75% average are the entry bar.

faculties.name: Faculty of Computer Science
faculties.line: Maths and English at 65 to 70% minimums and a 70% overall average; optional co-op.

faculties.name: Health programs (Nursing, Health Sciences, Medical Sciences, Social Work)
faculties.line: These close earlier than the rest, on 15 February; most other programs accept applications while space remains.

faculties.name: Faculty of Architecture and Planning (Environmental Design Studies)
faculties.line: Environmental Design Studies (Architecture) has its own deadline of 1 March.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering
faculties.line: Engineering allows at most 12 credit hours of IB transfer credit; entry needs the Maths and science courses on the IB page.

notes: Dalhousie's international tuition is a guaranteed annual amount for the standard program length plus one year; the 2026/27 amounts are CAD 37,992 for Science and 48,594 for Engineering.
From September 2027 some Standard Level IB courses graded 5 to 7 are eligible for transfer credit, as well as Higher Level ones.
International students on a study permit need a Provincial Attestation Letter; Dalhousie's page explains the steps.
